0.name: beginState
0.desc:
Begins an action (ANV start).
Specify the action name here.
Must be paired with ActionEnd().

2.name: sprite
2.desc:
Begins a sprite/cell block.
Specifies the sprite/animation and duration (frames).
Commands inside execute during this time.

6.name: ifOperation
6.desc:
Begins an IF condition using an OP2 comparison.
Stores result in a temporary variable.

7.name: ifNot
7.desc: Begins an IF condition with NOT logic.

8.name: ifOpponentCharacter
8.desc: Conditional branch based on enemy character name.

11.name: beginLabel
11.desc: Defines a label used as a jump destination.

13.name: gotoIfOperation
13.desc: Conditional jump using an OP2 comparison.

14.name: gotoLabelRequests
14.desc: Queued/reserved Goto that executes after the current processing block.

15.name: beginSubroutine
15.desc:
Begins a function/subroutine definition.
Must be paired with FuncEnd().

18.name: exitState
18.desc:
Requests termination of the current action.
Similar to ActionEnd but deferred.

24.name: gotoLabelIf
24.desc: Conditional jump if operand evaluates true.

25.name: gotoLabelIfNot
25.desc: Conditional jump if operand evaluates false.

26.name: setSpriteTime
26.desc: Overrides the duration of the current sprite/cell.

27.name: jumpToState
27.desc:
Requests a transition to another action/state.
May not occur immediately.

28.name: jumpToStateIfNotSame
28.desc: Requests a state change only if different from the current state.

30.name: ifPlayerCharacter
30.desc: Conditional branch based on player character name.

31.name: gotoForLoop
31.desc: Used to form loop-like control flow using conditional branching.

32.name: deactivateObjectByName
32.desc: Deletes objects associated with a given action name.

33.name: findState
33.desc:
Searches for objects with a specific action.
Sets a temp variable true if found.

34.name: interruptAction
34.desc: Triggers an action via an interrupt.

35.name: gotoLabelUpon
35.desc: Performs a Goto triggered by an interrupt.

38.name: deactivateObjectByNameExceptSelf
38.desc: Deletes all matching objects except the current one.

39.name: ifOnFrame
39.desc:
Frame-based conditional branching.
Equivalent to checking current frame timing.

40.name: endRunOnObject
40.desc: Ends a block controlling another object.

41.name: runOnObject
41.desc:
Begins control of another object.
Used to apply operations to that object.

43.name: stackObject
43.desc: Pushes an object onto a control stack.

44.name: operation1
44.desc:
Performs a unary operation.
Result stored in a temporary variable.

45.name: modifyVar2
45.desc:
Performs a binary operation.
Result stored in a temporary variable.

46.name: storeValue
46.desc: Copies a value from one operand to another.

48.name: checkInput
48.desc:
Checks player input.
Result stored in a temporary variable.

49.name: checkMoveFlag
49.desc:
Checks a condition flag.
Result stored in a temporary variable.

50.name: calcRound
50.desc:
Clamps a value within a given range.
Result stored in a temporary variable.

51.name: isObjectActive
51.desc:
Checks whether a specified object is active.
Result stored in a temporary variable.
